status: Software-level allowlist definition only. Virtual two-boot SSH acceptance is recorded in evidence/virtualization/ssh-login/. Gate 4 (#59) is OPEN and Gate 2 physical M1 acceptance is NOT_RUN; this file authorizes no release and claims no physical boot.

services.label: pid1.launchd

provenance.builder: PureDarwin image-arm64-virt Nix profile via vm/smoke-image.nix; scripts/build/launchd.py

services.justification: PID 1 Mach bootstrap namespace, RunAtLoad executable jobs, MachServices registration, KeepAlive supervision, launchctl load/unload and clean shutdown are the verified minimum job-management subset; a smaller substitute PID 1 program is explicitly rejected by the reuse audit.

services.label: org.blauos.sshd
services.justification: The single network-facing service of the minimal server. The wrapper is the dedicated initialization gate: it refuses to start sshd until the read-only kern.blauos_ssh_entropy_ready admission and the guest capability probe (account, PTY, credential drop, rlimit sandbox, chroot) pass. sshd runs key-only Ed25519 authentication for one named non-root account with password, root and forwarding paths disabled.

services.label: org.blauos.smoke
services.justification: Boot health and acceptance service: writes structured guest results to /dev/console and, in the standalone profile, exercises the configured network interface. It proves the launchd subset on every boot instead of assuming it.

runtime_components.name: launchd
runtime_components.justification: Real source job manager required as PID 1; see the pid1.launchd service entry.

runtime_components.name: launchctl
runtime_components.justification: load/unload and job inspection are part of the verified launchd subset; the only operator interface to the service manager.

runtime_components.name: dyld

provenance.source: puredarwin-vm-next src/Libraries/dyld with the recorded narrow vector overlay
provenance.builder: PureDarwin image-arm64-virt Nix profile; scripts/build/runtime.py audit

runtime_components.justification: The dynamic loader is the interpreter for every shipped executable; abort-path shims are documented as excluded from general support claims.

runtime_components.name: libSystem

provenance.source: puredarwin-vm-next src/Libraries/libSystem aggregation with llvm-project compiler-rt builtins
provenance.builder: PureDarwin image-arm64-virt Nix profile; scripts/build/runtime.py closure audit

runtime_components.justification: The independently built C runtime is the only library every shipped executable links against; load-command inspection rejects any other dylib dependency.

runtime_components.name: shell-dash
runtime_components.justification: The operator login shell for the headless SSH server and the script interpreter for initialization; PCC-style shell removal is rejected for an operator-managed server (see decision D4 in docs/audits/server-principles.md).

runtime_components.name: netsetup
runtime_components.justification: Configures the guest interface and resolver before daemon startup; SSH acceptance depends on the static guest address it applies.

runtime_components.name: openssh-server
runtime_components.justification: Authenticated remote access and file transfer. 10.6 requires both privilege-separation helper executables; ssh-keygen generates per-guest host keys only after entropy admission. The internal crypto profile (Ed25519/X25519/ChaCha20-Poly1305/AES-CTR) is recorded as experimental upstream.

runtime_components.name: ssh-start-wrapper
runtime_components.justification: BlauOS's answer to PCC's dedicated initialization (darwin-init): a fail-closed gate that checks entropy admission and runtime capabilities, generates first-boot host keys in the guest, and only then execs sshd.

runtime_components.name: ssh-capability-probe
runtime_components.justification: Verifies account lookup, permanent credential dropping, PTY I/O, resource-limit sandbox, descriptor passing and the sshd chroot inside the guest before SSH is admitted; compilation alone is not accepted as evidence.

runtime_components.name: acceptance-probes

provenance.builder: vm/CMakeLists.txt via vm/smoke-image.nix; scripts/vm/assemble.py required-artifact check

runtime_components.justification: Every current acceptance image ships these probes because boot, loader, bootstrap and shutdown claims require in-guest evidence. A future production profile may drop them only after a replacement attestation path exists; removing them today would silently downgrade acceptance to compilation evidence.

runtime_components.name: file-commands

provenance.source: apple-file_cmds 272.250.1 with apple-libutil 73 and PureDarwin libc FTS support; vm/commands/file patches

runtime_components.justification: Minimum file management for an operator over SSH; ACL, extended-attribute, color and secure-delete options are deliberately excluded at build time rather than stubbed.

runtime_components.name: admin-commands

provenance.source: apple-shell-cmds 216.60.1 and puredarwin-vm-next src/Userspace/ps; vm/commands/admin patches

runtime_components.justification: Identity, environment, clock and process inspection against the guest's own account database; needed to verify privilege separation actually happened in a session.

runtime_components.name: text-commands

provenance.source: puredarwin-vm-next shell/text sources and apple-text-commands 199 for grep/sed; vm/commands/text patches

runtime_components.justification: Log inspection and stream processing for a headless operator; compressed-input grep options are excluded because no source-built compression libraries ship.

excluded.name: launchd test fixtures (/etc/blauos-tests/org.blauos.test.*.plist, launchd-test.sh)
excluded.reason: Acceptance fixtures loaded on demand by the test harness; they are not services of the server surface and a release profile must not auto-start them.

excluded.name: OpenSSH client (/usr/bin/ssh)
excluded.reason: Built by scripts/build/openssh.py for host-side testing but not required by scripts/vm/assemble.py; the server initiates no outbound SSH.

excluded.name: Password authentication, PAM, root login, agent/TCP/X11 forwarding
excluded.reason: Disabled in the staged sshd_config (scripts/vm/assemble.py); key-only Ed25519 for one named account is the entire authentication surface.

excluded.name: Seatbelt sandbox profiles, AMFI, arbitrary XPC compatibility, xpc_create_from_plist
excluded.reason: Not implemented by the independent runtime; runtime/service-subset.json lists them as excluded, and sshd uses upstream's resource-limit sandbox instead.

excluded.name: GUI login sessions, window server, interpreters, debuggers, JIT
excluded.reason: Headless server profile; no such components are built. Matches the PCC dynamic-code removal principle where it applies.

excluded.name: Development entropy fallback loader profile
excluded.reason: docs/audits/ssh-entropy.md: a loader built without -DXNU_LOADER_REQUIRE_EFI_RNG=ON is development_only and must never start SSH or create host keys.

excluded.name: Embedded or shared SSH host keys
excluded.reason: Host keys are generated inside each guest on first boot after entropy admission; images must not embed shared private keys.

excluded.name: Editor, sort, package manager, zsh
excluded.reason: Not built today (docs/commands.md); additions require the same pinned-source, provenance and guest-acceptance path before entering this allowlist.

verification.virtual_ssh_acceptance: evidence/virtualization/ssh-login/checkpoint.json (two boots, 20 baseline + 11 SSH capability checks each)
verification.launchd_subset: runtime/service-subset.json (verified in fresh-source XNU virtual guest, GitHub run 38074322304)
